title: Release Train — Weekly Prep (Mar 4 2026)
body:
Meeting: Release Train — Weekly Prep
Date: Wed Mar 4 2026 (notes prep by Maya)
Time: 09:30 PT (sync 30m)
Attendees (expected): Jamie Chen, Priya Kapoor, Samir Patel, Evan Ramirez, Maya Singh
Goal: Quick go/no-go readiness check for upcoming 3/10 launch window. Surface blockers, confirm owners for remaining artifacts, and validate rollback/canary plan.

Agenda:
- Quick status round (5m): build/pipeline, infra, docs, QA
- Go/No-Go checklist review (10m)
- Open blockers & mitigation (10m)
- Action items + owners (5m)

Go / No-Go Checklist (run before 3/10):
1) Release artifacts built and tagged
   - platform image created and pushed (registry.redwood.ai/platform:release-2026-03-10) — Owner: Evan Ramirez — STATUS: done (CI #1423 green)
2) DB migrations validated in staging
   - Migration RT-274 ran on staging, rollback tested — Owner: Samir Patel — STATUS: in_progress (edge-case DB index still flaky)
3) Smoke tests passing (end-to-end)
   - E2E pipeline: nightly smoke passed 3/02, flaky on 3/03 due to timeouts — Owner: Priya Kapoor — STATUS: investigating
4) Canary & telemetry dashboards configured
   - Canary thresholds (5% error budget, 95th p95 latency) set in Grafana dashboard — Owner: Jamie Chen — STATUS: ready
5) Rollback plan documented and tested
   - Rollback playbook updated in Confluence (link above) — Owner: Maya Singh — STATUS: draft (need runbook dry-run)
6) Security review & secrets verification
   - KMS rotations verified for staging, production pending — Owner: Security (S&C) — STATUS: pending
7) Customer communications drafted
   - Release notes + possible outage notice drafted — Owner: Growth — STATUS: draft

High-risk items / Blockers:
- RT-274 (DB index rebuild): observed longer lock times in staging when concurrent writes > 1k/s. Samir working on an online migration patch. If not resolved, consider delaying index or use fallback smaller batch windows.
- E2E flaky timeouts: Priya suspects a transient infra autoscaler bump created cold-start latency. Need to validate with infra (ticket RT-289).
- Secrets/KMS not fully verified for prod: security needs a signed-off checklist before we ship to prod.

Quick mitigation notes:
- For DB index: run index in maintenance window with traffic routed to fallback nodes (option B). Samir to provide exact timeline by Fri 3/6 EOD.
- For E2E timeouts: add additional warm-up to canary (10% traffic for first 30 min) and increase retry timeout in e2e harness. Priya to patch test by Thu 3/5.
- For KMS: request emergency verification slot from S&C; if not available, limit rollout to Dedicated customers only and hold full prod.

Open PRs / Infra items to watch:
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1423 — integration tests passed, waiting for perf bench (Jamie)
- Infra ticket: RT-289 — autoscaler tuning for canary steady-state (assigned to infra team)

Rollout plan (short):
- Canary: 5% traffic for 60m, monitor errors, tail latency, token cost delta; if stable, 20% for next 2h, then 50% then 100%.
- Canary metrics: p95 latency, error rate, tokens/sec cost, KV cache hit rate, memory pressure on GPU nodes.
- Abort criteria: error rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m OR p95 latency regressions > 25% vs baseline OR OOMs on GPU nodes.

Action items (owner — due):
- Samir: provide migration patch timeline + test run result (due 2026-03-06)
- Priya: stabilize E2E harness timeouts + run targeted smoke (due 2026-03-05)
- Jamie: run perf bench and post results to PR #1423 (due 2026-03-05)
- Evan: confirm platform image scanning & registry manifest (due 2026-03-04)
- Maya: schedule rollback dry-run with SRE and update runbook (due 2026-03-06)
- Security (S&C): complete KMS verification or provide formal exception (due 2026-03-07)
- Growth: finalize customer comms + sign-off (due 2026-03-08)

Notes for meeting facilitation:
- Start with the 3 highest-risk items only (DB index, E2E flakiness, KMS). Keep timebox tight.
- If any blocker still unresolved after mitigation discussion, escalate to exec channel and propose limited scope rollout options.

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Post-launch performance experiment for quantization setting A vs B (research debrief) — follow-up with Applied ML (Samir to coordinate).
- Document cost delta analysis for new batching settings (Maya + Jamie).

Quick checklist (pre-meeting confirm):
- [ ] All attendees invited + calendar updated (Maya)
- [x] CI green for core integration (Evan)
- [ ] Runbook link included in agenda (Maya)
- [ ] Confirm infra attendance for canary tuning (Maya)

Draft talking points (for meeting):
- "Top 3 risks: DB index timing, e2e flakiness, KMS verification — owners and immediate mitigations."
- "If any of the above are not resolved to a low-risk state by EOD Fri 3/6, recommend holding full prod rollout and proceed with Dedicated-only release."

Questions for SRE/Infra during sync:
- Can we get a hotfix window to perform online migration with <2% traffic impact? (Samir)
- Can autoscaler steady-state be guaranteed for canary 5% -> 20% transition (Jamie/Priya)?

-- end notes --

Quick personal TODOs after meeting:
- Update release calendar and Slack channel with final decision (Maya)
- Kick off post-release verification checklist owner rotation (Maya)
